heading: The TV off. The lamp on.
body: Televisions, smart plugs and relays, and anything Home Assistant runs: on, off, or the input changed. The Controls face keeps the ones you use most a swipe away, as dials and buttons.
house: The lounge’s blue goes out. After the sun has gone, a warm lamp comes on in its place.
